decision: Do not promote true-Fisher residual. Perform one unchanged bank2 follow-up of both arms because the shifted-assignment control has positive mean gains in both orders.
selection_role: Shifted arm was a control and is selected post hoc; its bank0 outcomes are exploration, not independent confirmation.
stability: Shifted-versus-bilateral forward task-deletion range crosses0; reverse range stays positive but only7/16 tasks improve. Both orders are correlated. Effects and extra costs require follow-up; no hard threshold used.
cost: 521116 coefficients versus347666 bilateral,618037248byte original moments, plus2048example128VJP Fisher payload.
followup: Bank2, both orders, both unchanged conditions. Same strict calibration recipe and bank2 frozen bilateral/raw-column references. Estimate the bank2 Fisher payload once with the unchanged estimator. No Fisher shift, LR, normalization, rank or projection sweep.
